A mountain of corpses, a sea of blood. At the summit, only two people remained.

"Why did you save me?"
"At last... you're looking at me."
"I'll ask again. Why did you save me?"

The man was curious. It was natural. The woman was his sworn enemy. And their rivalry should have ended there. The final act was to be his death. Those he believed were his subordinates stabbed him in the back, and even more enemies rushed to target him.

"Answer me. Why did you keep me alive!"

Despite being low-level adventurers, they somehow keep getting dragged into one incident after another. One day, after obtaining a magic sword by pure chance, they even become entangled with the Demon Lord’s Army…

Leaving behind only a single key, Kim Woojoo's father, a renowned web novel author known for his 'Overpowered MC' stories, passed away. Ten years later, a virtual reality game called 'The Other World,' based on one of his works, becomes a place where people can make a living or even strike it rich.

Kim Woojoo has been living a tough life with no special advantages. By chance, he discovers that the key, a keepsake from his father, is being traded at a high price. He decides to use the key to open a limited edition book in his father's study and receives a special gift from the game.

Accepting the gift, Woojoo encounters the Great Demon King Lucia, a character from his father's web novel. Lucia grants Woojoo incredible abilities, but the power is so overwhelming that Woojoo struggles to complete even simple daily quests.

After much thought, Woojoo decides to eliminate the source of his power, the Demon King, by bringing in another character, Killer Zero. However, his actions draw the attention of Jason, a powerful player in 'The Another World,' who comes to confront him.

The life of primitive boy Dongwoo unfolds with his primitive family and the great wilderness of nature.

description.en:
The countdown of the human species began.  
The sun has come closer to Earth, causing radioactive rays that kill all female fetus. Some mothers even died during their daughter's miscarriage due to hemorrhage.  
  
Confusion reigned homo sapiens' first phase of extinction: mate competition, countries vying for a solution, families losing their loved ones. The government has required all females to take tests to collect data for research on developing a cure. Ho Su was identified as the one who is immune to the radioactive rays emitting from the sun. To prevent war between nations over her, Professor Yun has kept his founding about her immune a secret and has persuaded Ho Su's father to let him freeze Ho Su in hibernation, waiting for a time when the situation has stabilized from chaos to experiment on her for a vaccine.  
  
30 years later.  
It is now the year of 2042. The world has became a place dominated by males. Women are virtually extinct with their number-count in the hundreds and the youngest of the them in her forties. It has been long accepted that a wife, being a gender so rare, can have multiple husbands. Sex change to satisfy sexual desire is a growing phenomenon, although is still looked down upon by society.  
  
In such a disordered place where she is the only girl, Ho Su awakens.

description.en:
Elizabeth found herself reincarnated as the deceased first love of Ernst, the male protagonist of a 19+ dark novel. And to make matters worse, she ends up with the fate of an extra who doesn't even appear in the original story, dying at the hands of the traitor Karsis on her wedding day.

She tried to stop the rebellion to survive, but the scale of the mess the original owner of her body had caused was just too big. Not only had she had an inappropriate relationship with her loyal servant Karsis, but she had also wronged him terribly. Feeling guilty, she tried to set him free, but...

"That won't do. Betrayal, that is. If you throw away a dog that was already abandoned once, this time it might bite its master."

With half-crazed eyes, he was trying to kill me...? Wait, hold on. Ka-Karsis!

어떻게든 살아남기 위해 반역을 막아 보려 했지만, 아무래도 원래 몸 주인이 친 사고의 스케일이 너무 크다. 자신의 충직한 개 '카르시스'와 부적절한 관계였던 걸로 모자라, 그에게 몹쓸 짓을 저지르기까지?! 죄책감에 그를 자유롭게 풀어 주고자 했지만...

"안 되죠. 배신은. 이미 버려졌던 개를 또 버리면. 이번엔 주인을 물지도 몰라."

반쯤 맛이 간 눈으로 나를 죽이려고 하는데...? 아니, 잠깐. 카, 카르시스!

Known as the Explosive Delivery Man for his risk taking, bold resolve, and impeccable record, Banya agrees to complete a wounded soldier's mission to transport a parcel of great importance–not knowing what dangers lie in store for him and his friends! As their arduous journey begins, Banya promises, "There isn't a delivery I can't make. I always deliver."

description.en: By the time Princess Ophelia Lidania's fourth death rolls around, she's gotten pretty sick of dying painfully. However, she seems unable to avoid her fate of being killed by her half-brother Ewout Lidania. She's tried being nice to him, locking him up, and having him killed, but it always ends the same way. So, her goal for her fifth life is to just die painlessly. To this end, she hires the elite assassin Nau to stay by her side. But will this be enough to overturn her fate and bring her peace?
description.fr: Lorsque la princesse Ophelia Lidania meurt pour la quatrième fois, elle en a assez de mourir dans la douleur. Cependant, elle semble incapable d'éviter d'être tuée par son demi-frère Euth Lidania. Elle a essayé d'être gentille avec lui, de l'enfermer et de le faire tuer, mais cela se termine toujours de la même façon. Son objectif pour sa cinquième vie est donc de mourir sans douleur. Pour ce faire, elle engage l'assassin d'élite Noa pour rester à ses côtés. Mais cela suffira-t-il à renverser son destin et à lui apporter la paix?
description.id: Merasuki tubuh 'Ophelia', villainess dalam novel "Kembalinya Putra Mahkota" yang ditakdirkan mati secara tragis. Demi menghindari itu, aku sudah mencoba bertindak seperti malaikat maupun wanita yang jahat, tapi itu tidak berguna. Setelah mati karena dihukum penggal, hukum mati, bunuh diri, dan ditembak dengan anak panah, kini aku memasuki pengulangan hidup yang ke-5. Kalau pada akhirnya aku memang harus mati, bagaimanapun caranya, kali ini aku harus mati dengan tenang! Bisakah kali ini aku mati tanpa tersiksa?
description.ja: 小説「皇太子が帰ってきた」のラスボスであり悪役の「オフィリア」に憑依してしまった。 悪役であるがために、おぞましい死が待っているオフィリアは主人公の腹違いの弟であるエウトに殺されるエンディングを逃れるために死に物狂いで生きてきた。 天使のように、時には悪女のように振る舞ってみたが、どう頑張っても同じ結末を逃れることはできなかった。 1回目はギロチンでの処刑、2回目は車裂きの刑、3回目は薬による自殺、4回目は矢に突き刺さって死んだ。 結局オフィリアは五回目の転生を迎えてしまった。 もう死ぬなんてうんざり!どうせ死ぬならラクに死にたいの!エウトを皇帝の地位に就かせたのちにしびれ薬を飲んでラクに死ぬのよ! 今回こそは必ずや「上手く」死んでやるという願いを抱いたオフィリア。果たして苦痛を感じることなくラクに安息を得ることができるだろうか?
description.ko:
소설 <황태자가 돌아왔다>의 최종 보스, 악역 '오필리아' 에 빙의해버렸다. 
악역이었던 탓에 끔찍한 죽음이 예정되어 있었던 오필리아는 
주인공인 이복동생 에우트에게 죽는 엔딩을 피하고자 악착같이 살았다. 
천사처럼, 혹은 악녀처럼 굴어보았으나, 어떻게 해도 같은 결말을 피할 수 없었다. 
처음은 단두대 처형, 두 번째는 거열형, 
세 번째는 음독자살, 네 번째는 화살에 박힌 죽음! 
결국 오필리아는 다섯 번째 회귀를 맞이하고 만다. 
이젠 죽음이라면 지긋지긋해! 어차피 죽을 거라면 편하게 죽고 싶어!
에우트를 황제의 자리에 올린 뒤, 마비약을 마시고 편안한 죽음을 맞이할 테야!

이번에는 기필코 '잘' 죽고 말겠다는 소원을 품은
오필리아는 안락하고 고통 없는 안식을 취할 수 있을까?
description.ru:
Оказавшись в теле героини-злодейки романа «Возвращение кронпринца», я рассчитывала, что у меня, как и у других героинь историй о перерождении, всё будет хорошо.
В первой жизни тут мне отсекли голову на гильотине, во второй – расчленили, в третьей я отравила себя ядом, а в четвёртой меня нашпиговали стрелами. К пятой жизни я поняла, что смысла отклоняться от сюжетной линии нет, поскольку умереть придётся в любом случае. Поэтому в этот раз моей единственной целью будет обеспечить себе мирную и безболезненную смерть, несмотря на неожиданные попытки всех окружающих наоборот спасти меня.

description.en: In spite of his youth, the painter Kim Hong-do has been recognized as the greatest painter in Joseon (Korea). In the midst of wallowing in the pleasures of wine and women, he received an important mission from the king. Why did he end up in Japan? What is the secret of a landscape painting in Osaka Castle? Can this debauched painter succeed in his task?

Dohwa, Hanyang's best gisaeng, abandons the life of a gisaeng and tries to run away at night with her beloved man. But it was betrayal that came back!
'Why did you...?'
Without knowing why, Dohwa, who was murdered by his hand, fell into the cold water...
But when she opened her eyes, she had become a different person?!
"Madam, have I become a madam?"'
Hong Seo-hye, the main character of a romantic story that made a stir a in the whole city!
"Oh, my God. Oh, my God. I can't believe I'm a high-class lady.'
For a moment, I thought, "Let's get rid of the lowly gisaeng bitch and be loved by handsome husband."
What? Is this couple different from the rumors?
Where are all the stories of your romantic relationship that shook the city, and how come it's so cold?
All right, I don't know what happened, but... I, Dohwa, was the best gisaeng in the world. I'll seduce my husband first!

Mira’s latest VIP client is Euryx Deyra, an extremely friendly duke who feels the need to respond to every little thing she says. If only she could just tell him to shut up already...!
description.pl: Co może być gorsze niż ktoś, kto zostawia cię na odczytanej wiadomości? A co powiesz na kogoś, kto nie wie, kiedy zakończyć rozmowę? Ale to trochę trudne, gdy jest się szefem firmy, która produkuje odnoszące ogromne sukcesy urządzenie do przesyłania wiadomości. Najnowszym klientem VIP Miry jest Euryx Deyra, niezwykle przyjazny książę, który czuje potrzebę odpowiadania na każdą drobną rzecz, którą ona odpisuje. A young woman who works as a book-reading YouTuber falls asleep while reading and is possessed by the book she is reading.
